answer: A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the horizon graph. Re-attestations are stored in yarrow and ocean lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 5 peers re-attest it every 7 epochs, which means holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm of 4463 identities would post 2932 proofs and burn roughly 59 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
